title: AI Supplier Risk Assessment System
short: Scores API, excipient and service suppliers on quality, delivery and dependency risk to focus audits and dual-sourcing efforts.
symptom: A single supplier problem stops the whole product
directions: Load supplier performance, audit and complaint data. Get a ranked risk register with the reasons behind each score.
problem: Companies depend on many suppliers, often single-sourced; quality issues, late deliveries, regulatory actions and concentration risk are tracked in separate systems.
why: Supplier failures cause shortages, quality defects and regulatory findings, and supplier oversight is a GMP expectation.
solution: Combines delivery performance, complaint and deviation history, audit outcomes, public regulatory actions and dependency (single source, single country) into an explainable risk score that guides audits and mitigation.
limitations: Public information about suppliers is incomplete
Scores must be calibrated with quality and procurement experts
review: Supplier quality and procurement teams approve risk ratings and mitigation actions.
